    Byte 1:     SM algorithm
    Bytes 2-3:  Challenge max length (big-endian uint16)
    Bytes 4-5:  Certificate max length (big-endian uint16)
    Bytes 6-7:  Special DO max length (big-endian uint16)
    Byte 8:     PIN block 2 format supported (0x01 = true)
    Byte 9:     MSE command supported (0x01 = true)

        (data_count, trailing) = divmod(total, len(data))
        feed data data_count times into hash

Bytes 0-5:   RID + PIX prefix
    Bytes 6-7:   OpenPGP version (BCD encoded)
    Bytes 8-9:   Manufacturer ID (big-endian uint16)
    Bytes 10-13: Serial number (BCD encoded, or raw uint32 if invalid BCD)

TLV(0x4D,

- id: openpgp-exception
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: behavior
    v1: OpenPGP PIN verification failures (status-word-derived retry reporting, no dedicated exception type)
    v2: Yubico.YubiKit.OpenPgp.OpenPgpInvalidPinException.RetriesRemaining

      - yubikit:src/OpenPgp/src/OpenPgpInvalidPinException.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: The initial v2 snapshot had zero dedicated OpenPGP exception types (historical gap 9). Current VerifyPinAsync/VerifyAdminAsync map every unsuccessful VERIFY response to OpenPgpInvalidPinException (an ApduException), including non-PIN failures. SW 63Cx supplies a count, 6983 supplies zero, and 6982 triggers a status query; other failures or a failed query can leave RetriesRemaining null. Extended-mode fallback currently selects Reset Code attempts rather than User attempts, so query fresh GetPinStatusAsync().AttemptsUser and diagnose before retrying; typed zero alone fails to establish User blocking. Distinct User/Reset KDF salts also affect extended verification. Change/recovery commands propagate general APDU exceptions. See src/OpenPgp/README.md for current qualifications.

    migration_kind: member

      - yubikit:src/Ctap2/src/CredentialManagement/CredentialManagement.cs
      - yubikit:src/Ctap2/src/CredentialManagement/CredentialEnumerationResult.cs
      - yubikit:src/Ctap2/src/CredentialManagement/RelyingPartyEnumerationResult.cs
      - yubikit:src/Ctap2/src/CredentialManagement/StoredCredentialInfo.cs
      - yubikit:src/WebAuthn/src/Extensions/WebAuthnExtensionOutputs.cs
      - yubikit:src/WebAuthn/src/Client/Authentication/MatchedCredential.cs
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/Fido2/Commands/GetPinRetriesResponse.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/2026-09-14-public-return-contracts.md
    notes: "`refactor(applets)!: clarify public return contracts` (`84889b92`, PR #667) replaced several tuple- or bare-collection-shaped return values with named result types across Fido2, OpenPGP, and WebAuthn. `ClientPin.GetPinRetriesAsync`/`GetUvRetriesAsync` now return `PinRetryStatus`/`UserVerificationRetryStatus` (internal construction, additive-only properties) instead of `(int, bool)` tuples; v1's `GetPinRetriesResponse` already carried the same `(retriesRemaining, powerCycleRequired)` tuple shape being replaced. `IOpenPgpSession.GetAlgorithmInformationAsync` (tuple list) became `GetSupportedAlgorithmsAsync` returning `IReadOnlyList<SupportedAlgorithm>`; repeated `KeyRef` entries remain possible (one slot can support more than one algorithm), so this is not a dictionary. `CredentialManagement.EnumerateRelyingPartiesAsync`/`EnumerateCredentialsAsync` now return `RelyingPartyEnumerationResult`/`CredentialEnumerationResult` instead of a bare `IReadOnlyList<T>`, adding `ReportedTotal` (the authenticator's first-response total, independent of the returned count) alongside the entries; `CredentialEnumerationResult` is `IDisposable` and owns its `StoredCredentialInfo` entries (`using var result = await EnumerateCredentialsAsync(...)`), and on a mid-enumeration failure the already-decoded entries are disposed before the exception propagates. The same commit also added `StoredCredentialInfo.RawData` (a disposable, secret-capable complete-response view, unlike the non-disposable `RawData` properties covered by `fido2-forward-compat-raw-data`) and made `StoredCredentialInfo` itself `IDisposable`; direct `StoredCredentialInfo.Decode` callers must dispose the returned instance. Separately, WebAuthn's `RegistrationExtensionOutputs`/`AuthenticationExtensionOutputs` moved from positional records to non-positional records with optional `init` properties (construction syntax changes; all members remain optional and default to null), and `MatchedCredential.RequiresSelection` was removed outright with no replacement -- inspect `IReadOnlyList<MatchedCredential>.Count` instead. WebAuthn has no v1 comparison point for the last two changes because the package postdates v1. The same commit already added the `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md` 'Result-contract migration' table documenting all of these; this entry supplies the map record the guide's own convention requires to back it."
